title: School therapy pilot — state and buyer selection
status: Conditional target recommendation; no buyer or clinician committed

decision.discipline: SLP first, subject to an available qualified clinician; OT/PT are separate expansion decisions
decision.headline: Validate a small, in-person SLP pilot in Rockland County, New York.
decision.rationale: East Ramapo has a current SLP-specific purchasing route and explicitly contemplates part-time individual sessions through full-time leave coverage. Rockland BOCES has a second nearby discipline-specific procurement. This combination provides the strongest verified first-pilot prospect in the markets screened, provided the entity and named clinicians can meet the requirements.
decision.qualification: This is a recommendation about where to validate and pursue a pilot, not a finding that the new company is bid-ready, that these buyers will award work, or that New York has the best margins.
decision.time_sensitivity: The two New York bids close October 29–30, 2026. Recheck addenda and readiness before deciding whether to respond. If the team is not ready, retain the region as a research target and seek the next permitted entry window; do not promise capacity to meet a deadline.
decision.standing_alternative: Frederick County Public Schools, Maryland has a verified route to add qualified providers during the contract term. Its experience and reference provisions make it a conditional alternative, especially for an established operator.
decision.alternate_model: NYCPS independent-provider registration has no fixed deadline identified, but it serves a family-held RSA voucher channel. That is a different acquisition and service model from district staffing.
decision.funding_diligence: East Ramapo’s April 2026 monitors supported its budget and the district reports voter approval. Reserve reliance and administrative weaknesses still call for funded-order and payment diligence. Neither buyer has verified current payment-performance data in this research.

method.scope: Comparative public-source screen of New York, Texas, North Carolina, Georgia, Virginia and Maryland, with a bounded challenger search in other states. Not a 50-state census or a full credit, legal or commercial diligence exercise.
method.user_preference: No geographic preference or existing regional advantage supplied.
method.proposed_pilot: One buyer, one discipline, initially one experienced clinician and a cleared backup; expand toward three only against approved assignments. In-person delivery for East Ramapo. Pilot size is our proposal, not a buyer commitment.
method.unknown_company_inputs: Entity status, previous client references, clinician roster, insurance, payroll arrangements, working capital and commercial readiness have not been supplied. They are unverified rather than assumed absent.
criteria_in_order: Verifiable current purchasing access and actual opportunity type
Eligibility of a new or small provider and ability to offer a narrow scope
Exact credential, clearance, delivery and records requirements
Feasibility of recruiting and retaining a qualified local clinician
Funding, payment terms, delivery cost and working-capital exposure
method.ranking_rule: Qualitative priority with explicit gates. No weighted numerical score: comparable local supply, pay, rates and payment-performance data are missing. An unknown is not scored as favorable.
method.evidence_rule: Primary buyer documents establish procurement terms. Official boards and statutes establish specific credential/entity rules. Aggregator listings are discovery leads only. Current headings, jobs, historic contracts and vendor registration do not prove an open staffing order.
method.date_rule: All availability labels are a snapshot as of October 20, 2026. Expired deadlines remain closed unless a current primary source establishes another entry mechanism. Future deadlines require a fresh addendum check before action.
method.ai_scope: AI agents can prepare recruiting, credential evidence, scheduling, time reconciliation and invoice workflows under defined permissions. Licensed clinicians deliver therapy and retain clinical judgment; the school retains IEP authority. This research does not establish autonomous operation or permission to use student data in AI systems.

priorities.label: First pilot target
priorities.why: SLP-specific bid; explicitly variable part-time and leave-cover assignments; clinician-level evidence is central.
priorities.gate: Named dual-credentialed clinicians, organizational capability, insurance, funded assignments and payment diligence. In-person only.
priorities.confidence: High on advertised scope and current route; low on win probability, supply and economics.

priorities.label: Second buyer in the same county
priorities.why: Separate discipline-specific RFPs; individuals or organizations may respond; planned December 2026 start supports preparation time after award.
priorities.gate: Experience/references, substantial insurance, geographic scope, transportation and same-day records workflow. No guaranteed assignments.
priorities.confidence: High on procurement existence; medium on small-team delivery fit until task scope is known.

priorities.label: Best verified ongoing district entry route
priorities.why: Current contract allows additional qualified providers during its term, avoiding an artificial launch deadline.
priorities.gate: Five-year history provision with position exceptions, five client references and in-person capability need explicit eligibility resolution. Agency subcontracting is restricted.
priorities.confidence: High on documented addition mechanism; unresolved for this operator's eligibility.

priorities.label: Texas verification target
priorities.why: Potential continuous-entry procurement would improve timing; Texas has a documented professional-license school SLP pathway.
priorities.gate: Continuous-entry status and complete current packet are not primary-verified. Do not treat it as an open award opportunity.
priorities.confidence: Low on current therapy access; general purchasing process verified.

priorities.label: Future-cycle small-school target
priorities.why: North Carolina charter-network procurement allowed individual schools and disciplines, a useful design fit for a small operator.
priorities.gate: Reviewed solicitation closed. Next lawful entry route, company experience/references and actual funded assignment remain unresolved.
priorities.confidence: Historical design fit verified; current access unverified.

state_comparison.name: New York
state_comparison.access: Two verified current Rockland-area discipline-specific bids; separate NYCPS application channel.
state_comparison.credential_fit: Agency school-age SLPs need professional licensure/current registration plus TSHH/TSSLD. The corporate SLP exception must not be generalized to OT/PT.
state_comparison.tradeoff: Best evidenced small-assignment access in this screen, offset by credential, insurance, travel and payment-diligence gates.

state_comparison.name: Maryland
state_comparison.access: Frederick permits additional qualifying providers during the current contract; entry requirements can exclude an unproven company.
state_comparison.credential_fit: Professional board license plus an agency employment-history review for direct contact with minors.
state_comparison.tradeoff: Flexible procurement timing is attractive, but experience, references, in-person delivery and contract-term conflicts must be resolved.

state_comparison.name: Texas
state_comparison.access: Birdville deadline imminent and conflicting later-deadline lead unresolved; Mesquite potentially continuous; Elgin identifier mismatch.
state_comparison.credential_fit: Documented professional-license pathway; school contractor fingerprinting and district clearance still apply.
state_comparison.tradeoff: Large certified-professional population is context only. Current new-company purchasing access is weaker than headline market size suggests.

state_comparison.name: North Carolina
state_comparison.access: Wake, Durham and smaller-network purchasing show real contract demand, but reviewed submission windows have closed.
state_comparison.credential_fit: DPI states a current NCBOESLPA license is the qualifying school SLP credential; district agency onboarding needs confirmation.
state_comparison.tradeoff: Clear credential pathway and narrow-campus bid examples; company references and current entry timing remain barriers.

state_comparison.name: Virginia
state_comparison.access: Reviewed therapy procurement windows are closed; no comparable current small-provider route established.
state_comparison.credential_fit: Board guidance expressly addresses privately contracted school SLPs; use fully licensed experienced personnel initially.
state_comparison.tradeoff: Operational licensing clarity does not establish open purchasing access or available clinicians.

state_comparison.name: Georgia
state_comparison.access: Reviewed therapy awards support buyer demand, with later or specialist entry requiring verification.
state_comparison.credential_fit: Professional-board and school-certificate applicability must be resolved for the selected agency placement.
state_comparison.tradeoff: Do not equate a broad staffing/MSP tender with an accessible one-therapist opportunity.

workforce_context.measure: ASHA members and nonmembers certified in SLP only who paid dues/fees in 2025
workforce_context.limit: These statewide certificate counts are not all licensees, school staff counts, local available candidates, vacancies or evidence of easy recruitment. They exclude the separate dual-certification category. Not used as a readiness score.

sources.title: ASHA 2025 year-end demographic profile by state
sources.supports: SLP-only certified totals in six states; PDF pages 22, 42, 66, 68, 88 and 94.
sources.inspection: Original PDF text extracted; New York and Texas table pages visually inspected. Only professional certification totals are retained.
sources.limitations: Certification totals do not measure supply available for this pilot.

sensitivity.condition: We already have qualified New York clinicians and a compliant ready entity
sensitivity.effect: East Ramapo and Rockland BOCES remain the leading direct-buyer targets; evaluate bid readiness against the October dates.

sensitivity.condition: We lack named clinicians, references or insurance for the current windows
sensitivity.effect: Do not force a bid. Keep Rockland as a research region, establish the provider operation and verify a later lawful purchasing route. No immediately launch-ready district is established.

sensitivity.condition: We have a five-year relevant history and acceptable client references
sensitivity.effect: Frederick can move ahead of the October bids because its additional-provider mechanism allows preparation on a realistic schedule, subject to buyer acceptance.
East Ramapo and Frederick fall out. Birdville lists speech/OT teletherapy, but eligibility and latest addenda must be verified; no ready remote-only winner is established.

sensitivity.condition: OT or PT is chosen instead of SLP
sensitivity.effect: Repeat the exact state/entity/role and solicitation review. Rockland has separate OT/PT bids; the reviewed SLP terms and New York corporate SLP exception cannot be reused blindly.

sensitivity.condition: The business accepts family-voucher acquisition and session billing
sensitivity.effect: NYCPS becomes a credible alternative channel. Assess authorized referrals, clinician utilization and collections separately from district staffing.

validation_plan.evidence_needed: Entity/employer structure, exact bid forms and current addenda, permitted client references, clinician resumes, insurance quotations and required registrations.
validation_plan.owner: Accountable business lead with procurement and credential review
validation_plan.stop_condition: No compliant evidence by the submission date; do not promise future capacity as current capacity.

validation_plan.evidence_needed: Consented availability and pay expectations; independently verified professional and school credentials; required clearance; experience; travel radius; cleared backup plan.
validation_plan.owner: Recruiting lead and qualified clinical lead
validation_plan.stop_condition: No qualified available clinician for the exact location, timetable and service scope.

validation_plan.decision: Is there a funded, bounded assignment?
validation_plan.evidence_needed: Buyer-confirmed need, authorized order, site and caseload, hours and duration, modality, documentation systems, cancellation/absence rules and escalation owner.
validation_plan.stop_condition: Only vendor eligibility or generic demand is known; there is no authorized assignment.

validation_plan.evidence_needed: Actual bill rate and worker cost; payroll burden; travel, documentation and unbillable time; screening and insurance allocation; invoice approval terms; collection timing and payroll cash buffer.
validation_plan.stop_condition: Required margin or payroll liquidity depends on unguaranteed utilization or optimistic payment timing.

validation_plan.decision: Can the workflow operate under the contract?
validation_plan.evidence_needed: Approved record locations and system access; school consent/data instructions; AI-provider permissions; clinician sign-off; time/pay/bill separation; substitute and missed-service handling.
validation_plan.owner: District, clinical lead and operations lead
validation_plan.stop_condition: Student-data or clinical authority is unresolved, or an essential district workflow cannot be supported.

product_implications.finding: New York agency SLP dual credentials
product_implications.requirement: Verify license registration and school certificate independently, including dates, role and any bilingual extension.
Maintain consented, evidence-backed candidate availability and proposal attachments; prevent speculative names or stale availability.

product_implications.finding: Small sessions and full-time coverage coexist
product_implications.requirement: Configure service, worked-time and invoice units per assignment rather than treat every order as a full-day shift.

product_implications.finding: Buyer systems and clinician documentation remain central
product_implications.requirement: Support approved district-system handoffs, completion evidence and exception queues; do not assume a replacement clinical-record portal.

product_implications.finding: Open procurement can still lack assignments
product_implications.requirement: Track prospect, qualified vendor, executed contract and authorized order as distinct states.
Track invoice approval/collection independently of payroll obligations and stress-test cash needs before scaling.

not_performed: No buyer contact, reference checks, clinician recruiting, account registration, bid submission, private portal access, credit certification or operating pilot. No firm-specific eligibility or legal clearance concluded.
